mapper.sql: select su.id, su.username, su.nickname, su.remark, su.enterprise_id, se.enterprise_name, su.dept_id, sd.name as deptName, su.email, su.mobile, su.sex, su.avatar, su.status, su.login_ip, su.login_date, su.create_time from system_users su left join system_enterprise se on se.id = su.enterprise_id left join system_dept sd on sd.id = su.dept_id
mapper.select: select * from system_users where username = #{username} and delete_flag = 0

select su.id, su.username, su.nickname, su.enterprise_id, se.enterprise_name, su.dept_id, sd.name as dept_name, su.email, su.mobile, su.sex, su.avatar from system_users su left join system_enterprise se on su.enterprise_id = se.id left join system_dept sd on su.dept_id = sd.id where su.id = #{userId} and se.delete_flag = 0 and sd.delete_flag = 0 and sd.status = 0
select count(*) from system_users where enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} and delete_flag = 0
select count(*) from system_users where dept_id = #{deptId} and delete_flag = 0
select su.id, su.nickname, su.dept_id, sd.name as dept_name from system_users su left join system_dept sd on sd.id = su.dept_id where su.delete_flag = 0 and su.status = 0
